web.orders: om frames after {"t":"o"} on the market data socket (since 73599f37c, #2507); an order socket of its own only while no market data connection is open; one order-book read after each new stream

notes: Noren streams five levels. A Depth 20, 30 or 50 subscribe is acknowledged with the depth asked for and streams five, as on the web (the adapter's success response names no actual_depth; feed::dialect, DepthAck::Echo).

PiConnect allows one session per uid (issue #1806). Since 73599f37c (marketcalls/openalgo#2507, issue #2386) the web multiplexes t=o on its market data socket and relays the om frames to its order adapter, which reads the order book once after each new stream for what a handover missed; the desktop reads them off the same socket and catches up the same way after each reconnect (broker_runtime::catch_up_orders).
